name: chrbailey-plugins
description: Tools from ERP Access for proving what your SaaS actually does, keeping all of its data, and rebuilding only what you need.

plugins.name: saas-rebuild
plugins.description: Evidence-cited KEEP / SIMPLIFY / DROP / DEFER verdicts for every feature of a SaaS or ERP tenant you administer, a checksummed export of everything you can reach, and a rebuild plan validated by replaying your own history. Starts from documented (not yet tenant-verified) export routes for 29 common B2B apps. The same protocol also runs with no install in a hosted browser workspace with your own Anthropic API key.
